The prior probability that Sable is Honest is  

\[
P(H)=0.4,\qquad P(D)=1-P(H)=0.6 .
\]

For an **Honest** informant each report is corroborated with probability \(0.8\) and contradicted with probability \(0.2\).  
Thus for one report under \(H\)

\[
P(C|H)=0.8,\; P(D|C|H)=0.2 .
\]

For a **Dishonest** informant each report is corroborated with probability \(0.3\) and contradicted with probability \(0.7\).  
Hence for one report under \(D\)

\[
P(C|D)=0.3,\; P(D|C|D)=0.7 .
\]

The reports are conditionally independent given the type, so the likelihoods for the observed data (4 corroborated, 2 contradicted out of 6 reports) are

\[
\begin{aligned}
L_H &= \binom{6}{4}(0.8)^4(0.2)^2 
      =15\cdot0.4096\cdot0.04 =0.24576,\\[4pt]
L_D &= \binom{6}{4}(0.3)^4(0.7)^2 
      =15\cdot0.0081\cdot0.49 =0.059535 .
\end{aligned}
\]

Now apply Bayes’ rule:

\[
\begin{aligned}
P(H|\text{data}) &=\frac{P(H)\,L_H}{P(H)L_H+P(D)L_D} \\
&= \frac{0.4\times0.24576}{0.4\times0.24576+0.6\times0.059535}\\[4pt]
&= \frac{0.098304}{0.098304+0.035721}
   =\frac{0.098304}{0.134025}\\[4pt]
&= \frac{98\,304/1\,000\,000}{134\,025/1\,000\,000}
   = \frac{98\,304}{134\,025}
   = \frac{32\,768}{44\,675}.
\end{aligned}
\]

Evaluating the fraction:

\[
\frac{32\,768}{44\,675}=0.7334750979\ldots
\]

Rounded to six decimal places this is **0.733475**.

\[
\boxed{0.733475}
\]

\[

and from low effort  

\[

The workshop chooses \(B\) so that the participation constraint binds at reservation utility 0 for high effort, i.e.

\[

\]

Substituting this \(B\) into \(U_L\):

\[
U_L = (10-0.8\Delta) + 0.5\Delta - 2 = 8 - 0.3\Delta .
\]

For high effort to be incentive‑compatible the artisan must prefer it over low effort, so we need  

\[
U_H > U_L \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad 0 > U_L \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad 8-0.3\Delta < 0 .
\]

Thus  

\[
0.3\Delta > 8 \;\Longrightarrow\; \Delta > \frac{8}{0.3}= \frac{80}{3}\approx 26.6666667.
\]

The smallest \(\Delta\) that makes high effort strictly preferred is the threshold value \(80/3\). Rounded to six decimal places:

\[
\frac{80}{3}=26.666666\ldots \;\text{→}\; 26.666667 .
\]

\[
\boxed{26.666667}
\]
